story.soThat: I know exactly what methods to implement for each plugin type
story.tasks: - Define IProviderPlugin interface extending IPlugin - Define IGuardPlugin interface for validation/security - Define IEvaluatorPlugin interface for output evaluation - Define ILoggerPlugin interface for logging backends - Define IWorkerPlugin interface for background processing - Create type-specific configuration interfaces - Add capability declaration interfaces - Document with JSDoc and examples

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - IProviderPlugin interface extending IPlugin with provider-specific methods - IGuardPlugin interface for request/response validation and security - IEvaluatorPlugin interface for LLM output evaluation - ILoggerPlugin interface for custom logging backends - IWorkerPlugin interface for background processing - Type-specific configuration interfaces for each plugin type - Capability declaration interfaces for each type - JSDoc documentation explaining each plugin type's purpose - Usage examples for each interface - Interfaces compile without errors

item.title: Product Requirements Document
item.snippet: FR3: IProviderPlugin extends IPlugin for LLM providers. FR4: IGuardPlugin for security. FR5: IEvaluatorPlugin for quality scoring

item.title: Plugin System Architecture
item.snippet: IProviderPlugin extends with validation, IGuardPlugin for auth/rate limiting, IEvaluatorPlugin for quality/cost tracking

item.title: Epic 2: Common SDK Package
item.snippet: Type-specific interfaces with unique methods: createProvider, validateRequest, evaluate, etc.

story-context.constraints: - All interfaces must extend IPlugin base interface - Type-specific methods must be async (return Promises) - Generic types for input/output to support different implementations - No 'any' types - use proper generics - Must support batch operations where applicable - Configuration methods must support partial updates - Capability declarations must be static/synchronous

item.name: IProviderPlugin
item.signature: extends IPlugin with createProvider, validateConfig, getCapabilities, getSupportedModels

item.name: IGuardPlugin
item.signature: extends IPlugin with validateRequest, validateResponse, getGuardType, getRules

item.name: IEvaluatorPlugin
item.signature: extends IPlugin with evaluate, getMetrics, configure, batchEvaluate

tests.standards: Jest unit tests, verify interface extensions, test generic type parameters
tests.ideas: - Verify each interface extends IPlugin - Test type-specific method signatures - Mock implementations for each plugin type - Test generic type parameters work correctly - Verify batch operations where applicable - Test configuration partial updates
